summary: Configured Fractal web browsers export input-to-paint spans for owned control, field, transcript-tail and overlay commits through existing OTLP traces, with bounded observation, ingest exclusion and queued presentation draining at lifecycle boundaries.

compatibility.detail: Adds fractal.input.next_frame spans under service.name=fractal-web with final painted/coalesced/unacknowledged outcomes. No new exporter, dependencies or wire protocol.

manual.detail: No installation action required. Existing VITE_OTLP_TRACES_URL configuration controls export.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery changes.
